Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 7F 1C 00 <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
No identity check: the data list prints the identity reply with the family bytes as `dd dd` (4C 06 for the MOXF6, 4D 06 for the MOXF8).

Parameter changes at 40-42 (Normal Voice) and 46-47 (Drum Voice) edit the voice in the Voice mode's edit buffer; Pull asks for each edit buffer (Normal Voice, Drum Voice, Performance, Multi, Master), whichever mode the instrument is in.
